title: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Members of Parliament Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 1985
ACT XII OF 1985
MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Members of Parliament (Salaries and
Allowances) Act, 1974
[Gezette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called Members of Parliament (Salaries and
Allowances) (Amendment) Act,
1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of March, 1985.

5. Substitution of section 9, Act XXVII of 1974.----In the said Act, for section 9 the following
shall be substituted, namely :-
"9. Housing allowance.-A member shall be paid a housing allowance at
the rate of three hundred rupees for each day during any period of residence on
duty.".

An Act further to amend the Members of Parliament (Salaries and

[Gezette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 15th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
7. Substitution of section 11, Act XXVII of 1974.--In the said Act, for section 11 the
following shall be substituted, namely :-
"11. Telephone.-A
member shall be entitled to have a telephone installed at his residence at
Government expenses where facilities for installation are available and to a
monthly allowance of five hundred rupees on account of telephone charges,
whether a telephone is so installed or not."
